stem:
Javed holds a cardboard cut-out between a torch and a white wall.

Which change makes the shadow on the wall smaller?

options.text: moving the cut-out closer to the wall
moving the cut-out closer to the torch

teacher.key_rationale: Moving the object toward the wall shrinks the shadow. Moving it toward the torch enlarges it. Switching the torch off removes the light needed for a shadow. Brightness is a surface cue that does not shrink the shadow.

mx_swap.reason: Sphere CWO invents a sphere not in the stem; used surface_feature_capture on torch brightness instead.
